# GreenMech Automation

> ISO 9001 certified precision machining company in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

GreenMech Automation is a premier provider of CNC turning, VMC milling, and surface grinding services. We serve industries including aerospace, oil & gas, wind energy, automotive, and automation. Certified by TUV India under ISO 9001.

## Services
- VMC (Vertical Machining Centre) Machining
- CNC Turning
- Surface Grinding with HMI
- Heavy Rough Milling
- M1TR DRO Milling

## Industries Served
- Aerospace
- Oil & Gas
- Wind Energy
- Automobiles
- Automation
- Jigs & Fixtures
- Valve Components
- Precision Surface Grinding
